title: What If You Grew Two Inches Taller? Astronauts Do

scenes.text: What if you grew two inches taller without eating a thing? Astronauts do it.
In space, NASA scientists say astronauts can grow up to three percent taller.
For a six-foot person, that is as much as two inches, or about five centimeters.
On Earth, gravity squeezes your spine all day. In orbit, nothing pushes down on it.
The vertebrae relax and spread apart, so the whole column lengthens while you float.
The catch? It doesn't last. After returning, height goes back to normal within a few months.

description:
What if you grew two inches taller overnight?
In microgravity an astronaut's spine can lengthen by up to three percent, but the gain fades within months of coming home.
